upsert.title: B7H3-targeted CAR-iNKT cell therapy for newly diagnosed canine osteosarcoma
upsert.contacts: Penn Vet Comparative Immunotherapy Program — contact through the current study page
upsert.funding: Fully funded including initial screening, study cell therapy, amputation/post-operative care, standard-of-care chemotherapy and study monitoring, as stated by the AVMA Veterinary Clinical Trials Registry; confirm current coverage with Penn Vet.
upsert.notes: Investigational B7H3-targeted CAR-iNKT cell therapy for dogs with newly diagnosed osteosarcoma. This is a distinct protocol from Penn's CAR-iNKT study for dogs with metastatic osteosarcoma. Treatment is followed by amputation and standard-of-care chemotherapy; full eligibility requires Penn Vet prescreening.

upsert.title: Chemotherapy with temozolomide and propranolol for canine hemangiosarcoma
upsert.center: UT Southwestern Veterinary Radiation Oncology Clinic (VROC)
upsert.status: Recruiting; current recruitment period reported through January 8, 2028
upsert.funding: Unfunded in the AVMA Veterinary Clinical Trials Registry; confirm all owner costs with the study team.
upsert.notes: Treatment study for canine hemangiosarcoma using doxorubicin/carboplatin chemotherapy with temozolomide and propranolol. Public recruitment information includes splenic, hepatic, cardiac and intramuscular hemangiosarcoma. Full eligibility requires study-team prescreening.
